brands.name: Bauer Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped Pacific Northwest surfboards from Chris Bauer in Port Angeles — stock models tested in cold-water beach breaks.

models.name: Bull Kelp
models.description: Bottom contour features a deep nose concave which blends to a rolled bottom through the front 2/3 of the board. The last 1/3 of the board features vee panels with an edge. Rails are turned up 60/40 to the vee panel. Designed and shaped for the NW and our wonky waves. Will ride from the nose and the tail equally well, keeping you in the waves, no matter the weather. Easy cutbacks paired with plenty of hold through the turns, the Bull Kelp will make sections a lot of other soft tail longboards can't. (In Photo: 9'8" Bull Kelp)

models.name: Glider
models.description: Features a more parallel rail contour, and pointed nose and tail. The bottom rail is turned up to a hard edge in the tail to 18" up. Rolled bottom entry through the front 2/3 of the board into double concave through the last 1/3 and into the fin area. Provides early entry into waves, allowing the rider to set up a line early. It's shaped to trim to the max but is plenty nimble on the cutback. Gauranteed to up your wave count once you master the glide.

models.name: HP Driver Round Tail
models.description: Deep single concave from entry to fin area. Has a healthy rail rocker line and flat stinger. High performance step-up driver. Designed and shaped for easy entry into STEEP waves. Provides tons of drives and speed, has a healthy rail rocker and a flat stringer line provides plenty of hold through turns and maneuvers. Available as a thruster or quad fin configuration, with optional channel bottom.

models.name: Mini-Malibu
models.description: Wide nose, square tail outline with plenty of single nose concave to a rolled bottom. Tail has a slight edge 16" up for a responsive tail ride. The Mini Malibu is small in size, but rides huge. It has plenty of paddle volume and can easily noseride. Has a more agressive rail, with dialed nose and tail foils for a very responsive ride. Available in 2+1 or single fin options available.

models.name: Retro Fish
models.description: Bottom has a flat entry to a very slight single concave for lift. The last 1/3 of the board is a spiral vee panel off the tail tips. Foiled tail tips help to keep the board nimble. The Bauer Retro Fish is steeped in tradition. Shaped to ride and feel just like the 70's fish did. Paddles effortlessly with easy wave entry and draws skatey lines with an edge that can handle bigger carves. Available with twin fin configuration or double foil glass-on keel fins.

models.name: Spicoli's Speed Egg
models.description: The Speed Egg has a flat entry to a single concave under the chest and front foot. Has a double concave through the tail and fin area. Foiled rails, nose and tail for a very responsive ride. Most versatile and multipurpose board in the Bauer Surfboards quiver. Easy takeoff and plenty of speed and hold to surf just about all conditions. Available in round, rounded pin, and diamond tail options, 2+1 or thruster fin setup.

models.name: EVIL MONKEY

It has been designed with a flatter short board rocker, single concave, and a medium friendly rail that enables young surfers to progress and adapt quickly to the sensitivity of a regular short board. The outline through the nose has been widened for easy of paddling and the tail narrowed to increase maneuverability.
